cues: Many books still teach the starch sugar theory of stomatal opening.
Onion guard cells contain no starch at all, yet they open and close perfectly well, using potassium chloride.
In the exam, write about potassium.
text: A warning. Many books still teach the starch sugar theory of stomatal opening. It is history. Onion guard cells contain no starch at all, yet they open and close perfectly well, using potassium chloride. In the exam, write about potassium.
